items.description: Porto Grande is Mindelo's deep-water harbor and the main port on Sao Vicente. It handles cargo, ferries, and cruise traffic at the heart of the city's bay.
Porto da Praia is the main port of the Cape Verdean capital on Santiago. It serves as a central gateway for cargo and passenger traffic.
Porto de Palmeira is the main harbor on Sal, located by the fishing village of Palmeira. It supports the island's supply chain and maritime traffic.
Porto Novo harbour is Santo Antao's main maritime gateway. It connects the island to ferries, goods traffic, and daily supply routes.
Vale de Cavaleiros is the port of Fogo and the main maritime access point for the island. It lies near Sao Filipe and supports ferry traffic and freight handling.

Cidade Velha is the historic core of old Ribeira Grande on Santiago and one of the most important colonial sites in Cape Verde. It was the first European city founded in the tropics and is now a UNESCO World Heritage site.
facts: First European city in the tropics

items.description: Fortaleza Real de Sao Filipe rises above Cidade Velha and was built to defend the settlement from pirates. Its hilltop position gave the colony a clear view over the bay.
The Pelourinho of Cidade Velha stands in the old town square and marks the city's colonial past. It was a public symbol of judicial authority during the slave-trade era.
The ruins of the cathedral in Cidade Velha are among the best-known remains of old Ribeira Grande. They show the scale of the former religious center of the first capital.
The Tarrafal Concentration Camp in Chao Bom, on Santiago, was a Portuguese colonial detention camp. It became a symbol of political repression under the Estado Novo regime.
Fortim d'El Rei is a small fort in Mindelo on Sao Vicente. Built in the mid-19th century, it was used to defend Porto Grande Bay and the city.
